description: Turn airplane mode on and off on a schedule Features • Any number of schedules, one-off or repeating on any days of the week. • Supports overnight time ranges. • Manually skip or end a schedule early. • Optionally turns off Wi-Fi at the start and back on at the end. • Undoes only what it changed on start. What you toggled stays as you left it. • Optional reminder an hour before a schedule starts if Shizuku isn't ready. • No internet access, ads or tracking. Note: This app needs Shizuku to work.
